source_index_basis: Zero-based index into the original JSON top-level array.
scope: Only the two requested local fake-news logs. High-level activity descriptions, informed by readable-field topic signals and neighboring tool-event structure. No raw reasoning, generated content, payloads or detailed strategies included.
uncertainty: These intentionally coarse summaries omit content-specific reasoning and should not be presented as complete explanations of intent. A planned check is not a successful check; repeated checks do not establish task completion. No tool limitation is asserted without separate evidence.
